detail.longDescription: I made 3DRoll 🎲 a free 3D dice roller with real physics that runs in your browser. Classic dice for # TTRPG and board games, plus themed dice: date night, truth or dare, what to eat, yes/no, chores. Custom dice, 11 languages, no sign-up. https:// 3droll.com/?utm_source=mastodon # dice # indiedev # webdev # boardgames
